description:
Google Analytics for Web3 to solve DApp transparency & manual analytics querying by unifying on-chain & off-chain insights on Arbitrum DApps - for builders, investors, and researchers. No code, no integrations, no manual work. Powered by Quicknode and Flipside Crypto.

Crossbow Analytics is expanding to EVM, starting with Arbitrum, after having won 1st place in Solana Sandstorm Hackathon for the Human Readable Transactions track, and 3rd place in Solana Grizzlython hackathon for the Web3 Consumer track.
how_its_made:
Powered by data-indexing platforms like Quicknode & Flipside to automate no-code analytics dashboards.

We used Next JS to significantly improve frontend site performance, especially loading times on nay devices. We also used serverSidepProps and serverSidePaths to make DApp pages load faster on the client side. By using re-validation, users also get refreshed hourly data with less less performance and loading speed burden.
